home.why.title: Why BioAI Nav?
home.why.1.title: One map of a fragmented ecosystem
home.why.1.text: BioAI resources are fragmented across directories, GitHub repositories, skill libraries and research platforms. BioAI Nav brings them together in one place — a navigation of navigations.
home.why.2.title: Curated, not scraped
home.why.2.text: Every entry is verified by a human: a real project, a working link, honest metadata. We prefer 100 high-quality resources over 2,000 unverified links.
home.why.3.title: Built for the agent era
home.why.3.text: We flag MCP servers, agent skills and OpenClaw compatibility on every resource, so your AI agents can use this map too — not just you.

about.title: The discovery layer of the BioAI ecosystem
about.intro1: BioAI resources are fragmented across directories, GitHub repositories, skill libraries, commercial platforms and research labs. Before you can pick a tool, an agent or a dataset, you first have to answer a harder question: {q}
about.intro2: BioAI Nav exists to answer that question. We catalog the navigational infrastructure of AI in biology and biotech — the directories, awesome lists and skill registries that map the field — alongside the flagship tools, models, platforms, datasets and learning resources themselves. Think of it as a navigation of navigations.
about.whatLead: Every resource on BioAI Nav belongs to one of ten categories:
about.whatTotal: In total, {n} curated entries and growing — deliberately. We would rather list 300 high-quality resources than 3,000 unverified links.
about.standards1: {lead} Every entry is checked by a human before listing: a real project, a working official link, honest metadata. Dead or abandoned projects get retired.
about.standards2: {lead} Featured positions are editorial choices, not advertisements.
about.standards3: {lead} Open-source status, agent-readiness, MCP and OpenClaw support are recorded as facts, not marketing. A closed platform is listed as a closed platform.
about.standards4: {lead} Directories and awesome lists are not our competitors — they are our content. We link to the best of them and let you go deep where they are strong.
about.roadmap1: Periodic refresh of GitHub stars, languages and last-update metadata for cataloged repositories.
about.roadmap2: More programmatic topic pages as the catalog grows past each quality threshold.
about.roadmap3: Continued growth of the Chinese edition (中文版) alongside the English catalog.
about.roadmap4: Machine-readable exports — the catalog is plain JSON and stays that way.
about.contactText: The fastest way to reach us is the {link} — it works for corrections and feedback too, not just new resources. The source and issue tracker live on {gh}.
